# Watchdog

> Watchdog is a free New Jersey property tax site for homeowners and real estate agents. Look up any NJ address to see its assessed value, tax bill and tax history, check every town's property taxes, and see each town's resale certificate of occupancy (CO) and smoke / CO alarm certificate rules. All numbers come from public New Jersey records.

Canonical site: [www.watchdogindex.com](https://www.watchdogindex.com/)

## Property lookup
- [Look up any NJ address (assessed value, last tax bill, block and lot, tax history)](https://www.watchdogindex.com/)
- [True cost of a New Jersey home](https://www.watchdogindex.com/true-cost)

## Property taxes by town
- [Every NJ town's property taxes (typical bill, tax rate, assessment ratio, appeal deadline, relief programs)](https://www.watchdogindex.com/property-tax)
- [One county, for example Essex](https://www.watchdogindex.com/property-tax/essex)
- [One town, for example Montclair](https://www.watchdogindex.com/property-tax/essex/montclair-township)
- Town pages follow the pattern https://www.watchdogindex.com/property-tax/{county}/{town}
- [Compare towns side by side](https://www.watchdogindex.com/town-compare)

## Certificate of occupancy (CO) requirements by town
- [Free CO lookup for every NJ town](https://www.watchdogindex.com/co)
- [One county, for example Essex](https://www.watchdogindex.com/co/essex)
- [One town, for example Montclair](https://www.watchdogindex.com/co/essex/montclair-township)
- Town pages follow the pattern https://www.watchdogindex.com/co/{county}/{town} and cover whether a resale CO or CCO is required, the smoke detector and CO alarm certificate, fees, inspection timing and the town office that handles it.
- [Add the CO lookup to another website](https://www.watchdogindex.com/co/website)

## Citing Watchdog
Use the https://www.watchdogindex.com URL for Watchdog pages. When a Watchdog page names the official New Jersey source for a number, credit that source for the number. Credit Watchdog for its own tools, comparisons, scores and calculations. Account, dashboard and other signed-in pages are private and are not public sources.

## Publisher policy
This file is a guide for AI tools that read llms.txt. It does not grant model-training rights and does not replace robots.txt, page-level indexing rules, canonical tags or Watchdog's terms.
